title: Data Structures
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a phenomenon that occurs in a long-running programme that has undergone garbage collection several times."
The Fragmentation Problem Fragmentation is a phenomenon that occurs in a long-running programme that has undergone garbage collection several times.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means i.Start with the smallest subproblems. ii.Combining these solutions, obtain the solutions to subproblems of increasing size. iii.Until the solution of the original problem is arrived at."

Bottom-up means i.Start with the smallest subproblems. ii.Combining these solutions, obtain the solutions to subproblems of increasing size. iii.Until the solution of the original problem is arrived at.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a data structure in which the data items are chained (linked) in one direction."
Singly Linked Lists A singly linked list is a data structure in which the data items are chained (linked) in one direction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a field in computer science whose overall goal is an understanding of the complexity of algorithms."
Algorithm Analysis Analysis of algorithms is a field in computer science whose overall goal is an understanding of the complexity of algorithms.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a construct made up of variables, operators, and method invocations, which are constructed according to the syntax of the language that evaluates to a single value."
Expressions An expression is a construct made up of variables, operators, and method invocations, which are constructed according to the syntax of the language that evaluates to a single value.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a stage-wise search method suitable for optimisation problems whose solutions may be viewed as the result of a sequence of decisions."
Dynamic Programming Dynamic programming is a stage-wise search method suitable for optimisation problems whose solutions may be viewed as the result of a sequence of decisions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the combination of two or more sorted sequences into a single sorted sequence."
Merging is the combination of two or more sorted sequences into a single sorted sequence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the implementation of an abstract data type in a particular programming language."
A data structure is the implementation of an abstract data type in a particular programming language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of assigning blocks of memory on request."
Memory Allocation Memory allocation is the process of assigning blocks of memory on request.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sequential data structure, i.e. a collection of items accessible one after the other, beginning at the head and ending at the tail."
A list data structure is a sequential data structure, i.e. a collection of items accessible one after the other, beginning at the head and ending at the tail.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called a tracing garbage collector because is traces out the entire collection of objects that are directly or indirectly accessible by the programme."
The mark-and-sweep algorithm is called a tracing garbage collector because is traces out the entire collection of objects that are directly or indirectly accessible by the programme.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to it as the "for loop" because of the way in which it repeatedly loops until a particular condition is satisfied."
Programmers often refer to it as the "for loop" because of the way in which it repeatedly loops until a particular condition is satisfied.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called the rows of A, and the n vertical m-tuples, its columns."
The m horizontal n-tuples are called the rows of A, and the n vertical m-tuples, its columns.
